notes.title: ver2.5.0 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the contents of the ver2.5.0 update.

ver2.5.0 primarily adds new treasure chests and Elite Reward Cards.

We appreciate your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.


New ImplementationNew Treasure Chests and Elite Reward Cards Implemented
A total of 11 new Artifact Cards have been added.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/0b756551bb37eb444ebe12f436dfc745b8df8134.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/591acac3321e1dc3033acc44dc27dd5b0d722470.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/ca4225a3c6222a02a2a4016d244941c4e3211d28.png"]


Specification Change

Card Selection Speedup
For mouse: Holding down the right mouse button while hovering over cards allows for faster card selection, but we've prevented it from responding when the button is released.

For controller: Holding down the confirmation button while inputting left or right allows for faster card selection, but we've added a brief pause when reaching the edge to make selecting all cards easier.


The second floor of the dungeon
When moving to the second floor of the dungeon, there was an issue where the destination might not contain any enemy tiles.

As this created a barrier to progression, we ensured that at least one enemy tile always appears on the second floor.


Implemented the “Curse Card” category
Enemy-generated interference cards were previously treated as active cards, but we've decided to classify them separately as curse cards. Curse cards can be identified by their card frame color.

Since they are no longer active cards, they are not generated by Overwrite and are no longer counted by Doppelganger.


To be able to return from the map destination selection screen
Descending the stairs from the dungeon previously took you to the destination selection screen, but you couldn't return to the dungeon from there.

Due to a specification change, you can now press the back button on the destination selection screen to return to the dungeon and claim any unreceived rewards.


Ability Change for "Wings of the Whirlwind"
The trigger ability required confirmation and was cumbersome, so I remade it as an activate ability with similar functionality. The changes are as follows:

\[Activate] Once per turn, during your turn when you activate a card with an original MP cost of 5 or more, you may activate this ability. You move one space forward.


HP recovery at story cell
Since HP recovery events occurring when stamina is already sufficient serve no purpose, we've changed the specification so that recovery events now occur only when HP is 80% or lower.


Card Processing Speed Improvement
We have revised the card activation animation to reduce the time it takes to display.


Partially revised button UI



The illustration on the Smirna movement card has been revised to match the intended image.
The illustration on the Smirna movement card has been changed. We may continue to modify illustrations that do not align with the intended image.
Bug FixesScreen Scrolling
We have fixed a bug where scrolling the dungeon screen with the mouse during combat could cause the screen to become stuck if scrolled too far.


Enemy Card Text Corrections
Corrected the text for Sortraps and Memory Leak.


Intervention of Law Text Correction
Corrected two consecutive periods.

notes.title: ver2.4.0 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the contents of the ver2.4.0 update.  In this update, we have added default cards and fixed bugs.  We look forward to your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.


New ImplementationNew Card Implementation
We have added two cards for each character. With this update, we have completed the task of adding four cards to each character's default card pool, as mentioned in the previous update milestone.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/eaef74aac45fa08036b68174b943af8f0a61385f.png"]


Card Selection Speed Improvement 
This feature addresses the issue of cumbersome processing when selecting multiple cards at once to choose their cost or target.

Selection can be performed using the following methods:  Mouse: Right-click while hovering over the card selection.

Controller: Hold down the Select button while inputting left or right.


Spec Changes"Spirit Form" Spec Change
"Spirit Form" ability reduces all damage to 1, but we have prevented 0 damage from increasing to 1 damage.


Mass Defect Specification Change
Mass Defect now requires payment of both MP cost and non-MP cost simultaneously. While this change has minimal impact, it was necessary to address an issue where paying the Mass Defect cost failed when sending a Super Conductor to the graveyard using Mass Defect's cost.


Card Reward Visual Changes
We added particles to the appearance of card rewards displayed in the dungeon to make them more noticeable.


“Myasma” Specification Change
We changed the trigger ability activation condition of “Myasma” to when a card is played from the hand.
Dungeon Camera Position Change Method
We synchronized the scroll amount with the mouse position.  When you click, the camera no longer immediately returns to the center, but double-clicking the background outside of card processing will return it to the center.


Bug fixes
We have fixed an issue where card rewards could not be obtained when their position overlapped with the position of stairs in the dungeon.

We have fixed a bug where “Arc Tempest” was being discarded.

We have fixed a bug where “Metamorphosis” was being treated as an enemy-only card.

notes.title: ver2.3.0 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the contents of ver 2.3.0 update.

This update implements a new card expansion set!

Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.


Newly implemented
We have implemented a new card expansion set 4 for Lydia and Smyrna respectively.

It focuses on the newly implemented “Wound” and “Charge” enchantments.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/c972600f891829fdd960843ad92ac3bab5cedadc.png"]

Wounds (Debuff)
'Damage taken is +X. Each time you take damage, the wound value is +1. At the end of your turn, Wounds value is reduced to 0."

For each change in Charge value, deals damage equal to the Charge value to the nearest enemy in two surrounding squares."

notes.title: ver2.2.2 Update Contents

notes.title: ver2.2.1 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the contents of ver2.2.1 update.
The ver2.2.1 update mainly fixes bugs.
Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

Specification changes

Fixed Achievements for Score Acquisition
There was a problem with the achievement of obtaining a score of 2000, which did not take into account the score obtained depending on the difficulty level.
This has been corrected so that the achievement can be achieved by obtaining 1500 for Normal and 1800 for Hard.

Fixed the ability of Holy Light
Fixed that cards costing 0 and X are no longer eligible for the Holy Light when the cost is set to 1.

Defiance spec changes
When adding a card with Defiance, it now does not add its own card.
No modifications have been made to the card text.

Bug fixes

Fixed a bug in which achievements were reflected incorrectly
Total amount of HP recovered by card abilities
Total amount of HP recovered by events
Total amount of MP gained
Total amount of enchantments gained
There was a glitch that prevented the achievements from being unlocked because these were recording the maximum values as the achievements instead of the total.
We apologize for the confusion.

Card direction selection bug
Fixed a bug that caused the direction to be rewritten to the direction of the card being activated when a card was placed in standby mode by the delayed play function during card processing, such as Continuous Break.

Bug in the order selection of trigger abilities
Fixed a bug that caused an inability to progress when the order selection of trigger abilities occurred at the start of a battle under certain circumstances.

Bug where the BGM did not change on the Achievements screen
Fixed a bug where the BGM would not change when navigating directly from the title to the Achievements screen.

Damage of generated “piercing shots” was incorrect
When a peering shot was generated, the number of times the peering shot was sent to the graveyard from the start of the battle was not calculated correctly, resulting in an incorrect amount of damage.
This has been corrected so that the count is now reflected correctly when generated.

Controller not playing next card immediately
Fixed a problem with controllers where pressing the decision key after playing a card would not immediately put the next card in standby for play.

Drag-and-drop issue
Fixed a problem in which dragging and dropping a card with the mouse and clicking immediately after releasing it would cause another card to be dragged.

Scrolling problem on the library screen
Fixed a problem in the library screen where scrolling on a filter item would cause the card to scroll with it.

notes.title: ver2.2.0 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the contents of ver2.2.0 update.
The ver2.2.0 update mainly implements Steam Achievements and adds new features.
We look forward to your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

Additional Features

Completed implementation of Steam Achievements
Added the ability to unlock Steam Achievements and created images for achievements.
If you have already cleared an achievement locally, the achievement will be automatically unlocked when you start the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/88f096dc8f244b06edb13735f095f693e8bedb79.png

Delayed card play
Until now, it was not possible to play cards while the ability was being processed, but starting with this update, cards will be played automatically after the process is complete if the play operation is performed during processing.

Automatic end-of-turn function
Added the ability to automatically end the turn if there are no cards available to play next when card processing is finished.
This is applied when the checkbox in the config is turned on.

Enchantment hyperlinks
Hovering over an enchantment description in card text will now bring up the enchantment description.

Keyword hyperlinks
Hovering the cursor over a keyword description in card text now brings up a description of the keyword.

Display loading screen
The method of obtaining resources for dungeon artifacts has been slightly changed.
The black screen time immediately after starting the game has been shortened, but including the loading screen display time, it is not that different from before...

Make it possible to get the card rewards again when the game is cleared
After clearing, the reward card is now dropped, and even if you cancel getting the card, you can go to the reward screen again by navigating to the card on the map.


Specification changes

New cards have been added to the initial deck. 
Lydia
"Shadow Fang"
1 cost
Deals 4 damage to 2 squares in front of you. Gains +3 enhancement until end of turn.

Smyrna
"Energy Bolt"
1 cost
[cost]Send 1 card from your hand to the graveyard. Deal 4 damage to the front 3 squares. Gain +1 rage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/367cf3879c0fa13b35a64e06f94f54d02e1a2f32.png

Adjustment of some abilities like “make the cost 1”
Some “make cost 1” like abilities have been modified to exclude 0-cost and X-cost cards.
This is to counteract the problem of 0-cost cards conversely increasing the cost and X-cost cards only being able to select X=0.

Improved operation when directionally selecting copied cards
The direction could not be specified without moving the mouse a little.

Added pending to phantom blade
A pending ability has been added to the phantom blade. The reason for this is that playing empty to prevent the phantom blade from being added to the deck is sterile, so it has been modified so that the pending prevents it from entering the deck.

Bug fixes


 Fixed a bug where the initial bonus on the first floor would incorrectly increase only the HP if the player chose to delete a card and then returned.
 Fixed a bug where the controller could not see the cards in your possession while selecting cards in the store square.
 Fixed a bug that caused thorns to continuously inflict damage when you and your enemy had thorns.
 Fixed a discarding ability description shake and other notational distortions.
 Fixed a bug that required direction selection for “Wave” cards.

notes.title: ver2.1.8 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the contents of ver2.1.8 update.
In ver2.1.8, we have implemented some achievements and adjusted enemy card abilities.
We look forward to your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.


Additional Features 
We have implemented an achievement feature that works locally.
In the future, we plan to make achievements Steam compatible so that they can be unlocked.
Achievements earned in ver2.1.8 will also be reflected in Steam achievements.
However, this feature will only work when Steam functionality is available. Please note that this feature is only available when the Steam function is available.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/e2411cd9050adfbd99bae64ba8995593e786b642.png 

Bug fix 

Fixed a bug that allowed extra card acquisition 
at one level Fixed a bug that allowed extra cards to be acquired if the player continued immediately after selecting the bonus to select two cards.

Magic Stones Earned in Scores 
Since the score was being reflected as the increased value of magic stones possessed at the end of the game rather than as magic stones earned, the amount consumed was ignored and only the increased value was accounted for as magic stones earned.

Bug where process was not terminated 
Fixed a bug where terminating the Dungeon Artifact game did not completely terminate the game and the process remained in the task manager.
This was a bug in Unity (game development software) and has been resolved through an update.

Specification change 

Steam authentication 
You can now only open dungeon artifacts via Steam. Please be aware of this.

Weakened “Void” 
We have weakened the ‘Void’ card from the elite boss “Leviathan” in levels 21-30.
It used to take damage at the time it was drawn, but we modified the timing of taking damage to the end of the turn.
The reason is that Void's characteristic of being hard to erase from the deck is strong enough, and the way to deal with its ability to take damage at the time of draw is very limited.

Diviner deck adjustments 
We have made major adjustments to the Diviner deck.
very hard is often penalized for playing cards, so we adopted an idea that would reverse that.
Artifacts now have the following card text, which gives the player an advantage for each damage dealt.
 
 You get -1 reinforce and +1 wounded for each damage you take. [trigger] Activate if the value of Reinforcement is 5 or less at the end of your turn. You gain Reinforcement +12.
 

Weakened “Reactive Armor” 
We have weakened the Reactive Armor of the 20th level boss “Ruler”. This has the following objectives
Create an opening to play Reactive Armor again 
Prevent a situation where there are two Reactive Armors on the enemy's field 

“Magma Breath” weakened 
We weakened the “Magma Breath” of the 10-level boss “Phoenix”.
Modified to +6 combustion from +8 combustion.

“Tursos” demerit mitigation 
Modified “Tursos” play limit from 5 to 10.

notes.title: ver2.1.7 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the contents of Dungeon Artifact Ver. 2.1.7 update.
The changes in ver. 2.1.7 include bug fixes and specification changes.
Please wait a little longer for Steam Achievements, as they will be implemented in ver. 2.2.0.
Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

Specification Changes
Changed the initial bonus content on the first floor.
Random boss drop artifacts are now available in the Rare Card Acquisition section, and there are now three options to choose from. The rewards for the other choices will be enhanced accordingly.
The modified contents are as follows

 Gain 300 magic stones, max HP +10
 Remove 1 card from the deck, max HP+20
 Acquire 2 random card rewards (Rewards at the end of 3-choice battles x 2)
 Acquire a rare card (artifact reward from a boss drop of 3 choices)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/c9b854afc6c008a555951b85154cf0ed26454c64.png

Change in "magnetic field" ability
"Paralysis” has been weakened so that its demerit will be the same as before the weakening.
The maximum value of my MP is +2. I get Paralysis+1 at the beginning of battle and at the end of my turn.” The text has been modified to.

Enhanced "Magic Scroll"
Reflecting feedback on the cost payment and behavior of "Magic Scroll", the text has been revised as follows.
“[Cost] Send two cards from your hand to the graveyard. : You can activate a permanent card from your hand or graveyard without paying the MP cost.”

Changed the specification of "thorns"
The thorns have been weakened slightly and changed so that if they take more than 1 damage, the reflection is triggered.
Thus, there will be no more reflection damage when blocked by a barrier or when 0 damage occurs.

Change in behavior of “Sea of Dirac"
There was a problem with copying a "Sea of Dirac" in a "Multi Trigger" that caused an infinite loop and the operation did not return.
The text has been modified as follows, so that copying does not pay the cost, so the cost cannot be referenced and the operation automatically stands down.
“[Permanent][Trigger] Activate at the end of your turn. [Cost] Exclude a card in your hand at random. :Copy each card excluded by this card.”


Bug Fixes


 Fixed a bug that caused the mouse position to take precedence when trying to select the direction of a copied card with the controller.
 Fixed a bug where “Wings of the Gale” would trigger its trigger ability against enemy 5-cost cards.
 Fixed a bug where some cards copied by robbery could not be direction-selected.
 Fixed a bug where copying Absolute Zero would leave the ever-present ability of damage reflection.
 Fixed a bug where opening the deck screen during auto-movement could cause progress to become impossible.
 Fixed a bug where the mouse would hit the card on the SD character when the card was activated.


Card text fixes

 Added “other than artifact cards” description in "Noise Canceller" text modification.
 Added “generate” keyword to the "Lightning Bullet" and "Plasma Bullet" text.
 Added MP cost description to the Activate ability of "Scapegoat" and "Catastrophe".

notes.title: ver2.1.6 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the update of Dungeon Artifact Ver. 2.1.6.
There were some glitches that we wanted to fix as soon as possible, so we have addressed them in this version.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused, especially to those who experienced the glitches.

Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug in which the trigger ability of the card “Corrosion” used by enemies on the 32nd level was triggered regardless of the card's location.

Fixed a bug in the score calculation where enemies in the 32nd level were not treated as elite bosses.

In the card processing log, a bug was fixed in which the log position shifted as the upper key was entered.

notes.title: ver2.1.5 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the contents of Dungeon Artifact Ver. 2.1.5 update.
We have implemented mainly 32 level bosses. Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

Additional Features
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/2a1c62e8dda97054185ed855fc1facd60322e6d2.png

32-level bosses have been implemented.
Until now, the system randomly selected two 32F bosses, but the newly implemented bosses are now fixed.
The concept of the bosses was adjusted so that they would be tested to see if they could do damage from the first turn. However, the strength may be adjusted according to players' feedback. Please understand.

Added the ability to display an icon to show how many additional turns are available.

Specification changes
Changed the ability of the enemy card “Needle Storm”, which gives itself thorns for 1 turn, to add +3 obstruction for 1 turn to all enemies, as we decided it was not well designed.

Improved the UX of story rewards.

Bug fixes
Fixed an issue where it was difficult to select up, down, left or right in the direction selection when copying a card ability.
Fixed a bug where the control key icons would sometimes remain on the UI as semi-transparent images
Fixed a bug with the card “Grinding” used by enemies

notes.title: Ver2.1.4 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the contents of Dungeon Artifact Ver. 2.1.4 update.
We have mainly adjusted the reroll function and card abilities. We look forward to your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

Additional features implemented

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/0b7c608d395cad591adaff7a13d310c16450bdb4.png
Added reroll function
You can reroll by spending magic stones.
Initially, you can reroll for free, but the amount of magic stones consumed increases by 50, so there is effectively a limit to the number of times you can reroll.
In addition, rerolls can only be used for rewards for clearing the game; treasure chests and boss rewards cannot be rerolled.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/a77ba5e2842d503a6e0552ef8601035e0ce09958.png

A setting has been added to not display the status displayed above SD characters.

Added setting to not display enemy automata artifacts.

Added animations to improve visibility of enchantments.

Specification changes

 Changed the debuff “paralysis” so that the paralysis value is reduced by 1 at the end of the turn.
 Also, changed so that paralysis HP reduction is not caused by enemy attack knockback.
 The initial amount of magic stones was modified from 400 to 500, due to the implementation of the reroll function, etc.
 Modified to adjust the card power of the enemy card “Surge Voltage” to deal damage with the play ability.


Card ability modified
Enhancement

 “Ranbu” modified to gain +4 enhancement.
 “Impact” modified to gain +5 Enhancement
 “Heat Up” modified to gain +3 enhancement
 “Inferno Rod” HP reduction disadvantage removed.
 “Holy Light” Check the top 2 cards of the deck and put one of them into your hand. Reduce the cost of that card to 1. Modified to.
 “Mining” Added a disadvantage that it costs 0 and can only be activated once per turn.
 Modified “Drain” damage to 10.
 Fixed “Heal” cost to 1.


Weakened

 Removed swap accumulation +2


Fixed bug

 Fixed mana burn text to burn => combustion.
 Fixed a bug that could cause enemy status positions to shift.

notes.title: ver2.1.3 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the ver2.1.3 update of Dungeon Artifact.
We have made some specification changes and bug fixes. We appreciate all the bug reports in the threads, as it is not feasible to fix all the bugs by debugging only by the developers. We will continue to update the software.

Specification Changes

 The next boss can now be seen on the map screen.
 The volume can now be adjusted finely (100 levels). The volume can be adjusted with the left and right keys when using the buttons.
 On the character selection screen, the difficulty level selected by default used to be the highest difficulty level, but now it defaults to the most recently started difficulty level except when a new difficulty level is released.
 The ability display window now appears when selecting a card, even with keystrokes.
 The rarity of Shine Orbs and Life Absorbing Devices has been changed.
 Store prices have been revised downward across the board.
 The Magic Scroll ability now allows permanent cards in the hand to be placed on the field. However, you must discard two permanent cards as a cost.
 Cards that cannot be purchased because there are not enough magic stones in the card square are now displayed in red text.
 When selecting a direction when copying a card, clicking on an enemy should now respond.
 The layout of the automata detail screen has been slightly changed.
 The cancel button is now highlighted in the counter card activation confirmation.


Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug that caused the same behavior as pressing “yes” when trying to cancel the disenchantment “Can I destroy it?"
 Fixed a bug that caused the trigger ability to behave incorrectly when copying Dirac's Sea.
 Fixed a flagging error for three attack cards, Curse of the Fool, Blessing of the Poison Fang, and Dement. This fixed a bug that prevented Absolute Zero and others from being activated against those cards.
 Fixed a bug where the ability to sublimate would force a debuff regardless of position.
 Incorrect text for quick casts has been fixed. The behavior has not changed.
 Fixed a bug that caused an inability to progress if an enemy was defeated while a card excluded by an enemy's ability was being returned to his hand by a power stone.
 Fixed a bug that caused damage limiter and Path to the Void abilities to extend to other enemies.

notes.title: ver2.1.2 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the ver 2.1.2 update of Dungeon Artifacts.
We have fixed some glitches and adjusted some belly-hardware.
Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

Specification changes
Adjustments have been made to the artifacts used by enemies.

 [Damage Filter] “[Triggers] when an enemy gains 20 or more barriers at once.” Ability removed.
 [Inverter] “Gains +2 enhancement until end of your turn.” Modified to “+2”.
 [Lunar Gravity] “Lose Accumulation +3 each time you end your turn.” Fixed.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug in which the deck contents of Boss Elite were the same as in Very Hard, even in Hard difficulty mode.
 Fixed a bug in Berry Hard where cards in the deck would not return after [Oblivion] was used to remove them, even if the enemy was defeated.
 The behavior of the Spiritualization +2 gained by [Fortification] decreasing by 1 immediately at the beginning of the turn was not as intended, so the ability was corrected to “I gain Spiritualization +2 at the beginning of my first turn.” The ability was modified to.
 Fixed a bug where the text of [Disenchant] said that it could destroy cards in your field as well, but in reality it could only destroy cards in the enemy's field.

notes.title: ver2.1.1 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We have just released ver. 2.1.0, but we have updated it urgently because we found a bug that needs to be fixed.
Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

Bug fix

 In difficulty levels Normal and Hard, the enemy Nebula and Ruler's deck was incorrectly described. This has been fixed.


機能追加

 Card searches can now be performed using text in the library screen.

notes.title: ver2.1.0 Update Contents
notes.notes:
We apologize for the very long wait.
We are pleased to announce the ver 2.1.0 update of Dungeon Artifacts.
The main focus of this update is the addition of a new difficulty level, Very Hard. This difficulty is characterized by the fact that enemies stand in the way with artifacts. The difficulty level has increased significantly from the past, as players are now being interfered with from many different angles.

We will be adjusting the difficulty level of Very Hard to reflect the opinions of those who have played the game, so the playing experience may change in the future as a result of updates. Please understand this. On the other hand, the difficulty levels of Normal and Hard will not change much in the future.
If you have any comments about the difficulty level, please contact us in the request thread.

Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/e9ab928bba79c382d29f38eebcd487915b979cd9.png

Difficulty level Very Hard added

 It will be released if you have cleared the hard difficulty level.
 The contents of the enemy's deck are slightly different from the previous ones, so a different strategy is required.
 The enemies of Elite Mas Bosmas now possess artifacts. This ensures that the player's disadvantageous abilities are always at work.
 Boss artifacts are displayed on the screen and can be clicked on or viewed in text on the enemy detail screen.


Changed specifications

 In one level, you can now choose the option to get two random cards.
 Only for difficulty levels Normal and Hard, the amount of thorns in the 1-10 level elite boss helix (boss with thorns) has been changed to 2=>1.


Card ability fixes
Adjustments were made mainly to Lydia's cards that did not have a role or low output.

 [Windthrust] 8=>11 damage modified.
 [Windstorm Charge] 6=>10 damage modified.
 [Combat readiness] Modified to gain an additional +2 rage.
 [Night Curtain] Modified to barrier 2=>4.
 [Iron Wall] Eliminate restrictions on cost 5 or more.
 [Eye of Typhoon] Modified to Barrier 6=>9.
 [Revelation]　8=>14 damage modified.
 [Fragment Fusion]　10=>16 damage modified.
 [Water Cutter]　Corrected to 1=>3 squares in front.
 [Cabrera Stone] Modified to  that it only triggers when you gain enchantment from your ability.
 [Stardust] In addition to damage, the ability is also applied when health is reduced.
 [Parry] Modified to 0 cost 5 barrier.


bug fix

 Fixed a bug where returning to the title screen from a dungeon and opening the config would not work properly.
 Fixed a bug where the number of draws for a black hole was 4 instead of 3.
 Fixed a bug that prevented [Revelation]'s ability from being activated.

notes.title: ver2.0.9 Update contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the ver2.0.9 update of Dungeon Artifact.
In ver2.0.9, the game seed value can now be set and some bug fixes have been made.
New difficulty level will be added in the next ver2.1.0. We will work hard on the production.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2412329411174142092/E39828AF96315C4E719127F2A0DC3CA7EC5C063B/
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2412329411174102230/A73F94E72621962AC9A4F34704D39C8677EAEBC5/

New Function

 Seed value can now be specified at the start of the game.
The range that can be set is from 0 to 4,294,967,295(uint.MaxValue).
As long as you play with the same seed value, the map structure and card rewards will all be the same for different plays.
If you start a game without specifying a seed specification, the seed value will be random.
The seed value will always be displayed on the score and config screens.
If the seed value is randomly determined, it will be displayed as a random seed value.
If it is set manually, it will be displayed as a specified seed value.
Note: Seed values prior to 2.0.8 cannot be confirmed.
 Even if you could, you would not be able to play the same game because the specifications are different.




Card ability changes

 “Kaleidoscope”
Modified card ability from “every time I end my turn” to “every time an enemy or I end my turn” to recover MP 


Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug in the event to obtain a magic stone when clearing a scenario, where the text was garbled.
 Fixed a bug where the back button was sometimes invisible when selecting a character
 Fixed an issue where progress would become impossible when encountering a boss while in possession of the Wheel of Wisdom.
 Fixed a bug in which the order of application of the Blasting ability was reversed.
 Fixed a bug that caused the draw ability of Liberation to loop infinitely

notes.title: ver2.0.7 update contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the contents of the ver2.0.7 update of Dungeon Artifact.
We are currently working on a new difficulty level, but it is taking time.
This time, we have updated the game to reflect the bug fixes first.


Additional functions

 Possession cards can now be checked even on the card deletion screen.
 Cards in possession can now also be checked in the card acquisition screen of scenarios.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug that caused progress to become impossible when an enemy's card "Drain Breath" was defeated by reflecting damage with "Absolute Zero".
 Fixed an issue where the game would become inoperable if the game was over while the enemy screen or card area screen was open in a dungeon.
 Fixed a bug that prevented players from obtaining rewards even if they moved diagonally in the direction of treasure chests.
 Fixed a bug in which the color of the attack range of some cards would sometimes be the same as that of the enemy.
 Changed the way text is displayed in the start menu and configurations due to a reported problem with garbled text on some devices


We are working hard on a new difficulty level, so please wait for a while until it is implemented.
Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

notes.title: ver2.0.6 update contents
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience.
We are pleased to announce the ver2.0.6 update of Dungeon Artifact.
We have added some new features and fixed some bugs.
Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact!

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2459606329268357052/4428FFED517268670C3C2D3CA930846AC0C56DBB/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

New Functions

 Added the ability to move the screen viewpoint by dragging and dropping the mouse.
 Also, “back key + directional key” and “right stick of gamepad” can be used to move the viewpoint.
 Added the ability to click anywhere on a square when moving without enemies, and the character will automatically move to that location (mouse only).


Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug that caused loading of past game data when steam was not running and play data was available.
 Fixed a bug in which defeating an enemy with the end-of-turn ability would result in one more clear turn.
 Fixed a bug that canceling the target selection of {Tactical Reload} would be treated as already activated and could not be activated due to [cooldown].
 Fixed a bug where the animation when a card was removed from the field would go to the graveyard instead of the banished area.
 Fixed a bug in which quickly clicking on the next level after selecting a level to move to on the map would move the card two squares further down the map.
 Fixed a bug where the cost of a [trigger ability] was also affected by cost reduction.
 Fixed a bug in which damage was determined to have been inflicted even if the damage was reduced to 0 by enchantments such as mitigation.
 Fixed a bug where the maximum MP value would be reduced if the maximum MP value was minus.
 Fixed a bug in which a countdown remained in the card text of “Spike Field".
 Fixed a bug in which the damage of “Destroy Laser” and “Plasma Laser” is now indicated as 12.
 Fixed a bug that the direction of “Mass Defect” could not be selected.
 Text of “Cabrela Stone” has been changed to "Gain the first enchantment again".


Changed specifications

 Pressing the upper key on the gamepad or keyboard to see the card details of the hand, but it is prone to mishandling. Therefore, it has been changed so that it can be viewed by holding down the key for 0.2 seconds.
 The player's attack range is now shown in orange to distinguish between the enemy's attack range and the player's own attack range.
 Clear time is displayed on the result screen.
 The specification was such that the target of a "Dual cast" could not be selected that could not pay MP, so an infinite loop could occur in which only a "Dual cast" could be selected as the target of a "Dual cast". Therefore, the specification was changed so that the target of a "Dual cast" that is a copy can be selected even if it cannot pay MP.



Card Adjustment
Black Hole's infinite loop was determined to be X cards draw was not good, so it was adjusted to fixed 3 cards draw.
Since the infinite loop can be easily achieved when combined with “Synthsize,” we made some adjustments to increase the number of cards required for the combo by one or two.

notes.title: ver2.0.5 update contents
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the contents of the ver2.0.5 update of Dungeon Artifact.
We have added several features and fixed some bugs.

Additional Functions
Added the ability to make the mouse invisible and disabled during controller operation in the configuration.
Changed to allow simultaneous controller and keyboard operation.

Bug fixes
Fixed a bug in which X was not initialized to 0 for cards that refer to the number of activations, such as Storm of Bullets, Piercing Shot, and Reincarnation.
Fixed a bug where the cost of Destroy Laser and Plasma Laser was 2 instead of 3

Card ability changes
Catastrophe: changed to cost 3=>2, “[Permanent] All damage to you and your enemies is doubled. [Activate] You can activate this card on your turn. Send this card on the field to the Graveyard.” Changed to ability.
Water Cutter: Damage changed to 7=>10.

notes.title: ver2.0.4 update contents
notes.notes:
We had informed you that the update would be 4/19, but we apologize that it is now 4/20.
The ver 2.0.4 update will add functions and fix bugs, including support for the STEAM cloud.
In addition to that, we will be making upward and downward adjustments to card abilities to account for card power differences between characters.
Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

機能追加

 steamクラウド対応

 マップ画面にも試練の進行状態を表示させるように変更


仕様変更

 スタートマスにて、ボスアーティファクトの取得を常時表示するように変更。但し、10F以上でゲームオーバーしていない限り、最大HPを-20するデメリットが付く。


不具合修正

 スキップボタンが反応しないことがある不具合を修正
 レインカーネーションのトリガー能力が発動した際に進行不能になる場合があるバグを修正
 イモータルオブジェクト、アストラルバリアの影響が敵にも及んでしまう不具合を修正
 レインカーネーション、ピアーシングショット、ストームオブバレッツ等の、発動したカード枚数を参照するカードについて、生成したカードの発動枚数が0にリセットされてしまう不具合を修正
 ウィングヘルムがエンチャントに対して発動しない不具合を修正
 2回連続でストーリーマスに移動するとスキップボタンが表示されないバグを修正
 明けの明星のコストが次のバトルでもコストが下がったままになる不具合を修正
 フロストバーンが方向指定できないバグを修正
 キーワード能力のクールダウンのついているカードでも生成したカードや別の同名カードを発動できてしまう不具合を修正
 MPコストを1にする能力とMPコストを下げる能力が重なった際の、キッカーコスト計算の不具合を修正
 MPやダメージ予測の値が改行されてしまう不具合を修正



カード能力の上方修正、下方修正

notes.title: ver2.0.3 update contents
notes.notes:
Update was made in ver 2.0.2 due to a critical bug in the permanent card "Mapping".

Bug Fixes

 Fixed "Mapping" trigger ability always being ready to trigger.
 Fixed a bug that prevented the "Clone" ability from selecting possessed cards on the stack.
 Fixed a bug that prevented cards with multiple kickers from progressing past X=255.
 Fixed a bug where triggering abilities on the stack would trigger additional triggering abilities.


We apologize to everyone who was unable to play properly due to the bug.
Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.
